rowline.constraint: Original data must remain intact, and duplicates must not be removed without a decision.
rowline.solution: Originals separated from edits, undo/redo, and explicit duplicate decisions. Parsing and validation run in a Web Worker.

framepack.lead: One source folder, several sizes for the website.
framepack.text: Choose widths, format and quality. Compare the encoded variant with its source, then hand off a pack with the actual dimensions and byte sizes.
framepack.input: JPEG, PNG and WebP, up to 20 files. Animation is not supported.
framepack.resize: No upscaling. Each variant’s dimensions and byte size come from the actual encoded file.
framepack.output: A ZIP with images, a manifest and HTML with srcset. The user writes the alt text.
shapecheck.summary: From API responses to regression tests.
shapecheck.lead: Check which JSON responses the contract accepts.
shapecheck.text: Check a schema together with positive and negative examples. Error paths lead to the relevant field; after an edit, rerun the whole set.
shapecheck.check: AJV in a separate worker. Saving the project on the device is opt-in.
shapecheck.output: An editable JSON project and a ZIP with runnable Node tests. Node 22+, with no npm dependencies to install.
shapecheck.limits: Up to 20 fixtures; a bounded draft-07 subset. No OpenAPI, regex/format, remote or recursive references.
helio.summary: Choose a spot and see how the light changes.
helio.lead: A map point, a neighborhood and a time of day.
helio.text: Real building contours become a local 3D model. The timeline moves the sun and shadows; every height is labelled a cartographic estimate and incomplete data has its own state.
helio.note: RU / EN. Open horizon is an additional mode. Solar calculations are local; the map loads through OpenFreeMap.
helio.input: Search nine cities, pick a map point and set an explicit IANA zone.
helio.check: 300 × 300 m area, estimated heights, Three.js shadows and a ray test against loaded buildings.
helio.output: Sunrise, sunset, twilight and golden light with DST. JSON and ICS; a clear ray is not an illumination guarantee.
